existing_likelihood: README M1b already defines finite Beta-binomial present versus uniform-absent likelihood. The live calibrated Beta currently exists only inside projected_physical_evidence.cpp; Fragment::Look stores support/judged/seen-through counts, not the calibrated moments or per-cell fresh weight.
requirements: Keep since=segment first measurement and every fragment-local look; no inherited evidence from other states.
Positive on-surface or identity support must continue protecting valid partial views.
Do not treat overlapping support_rays and reliable_on_surface as independent pixel trials.
No-data likelihood ratio must be one, and no observation must not become evidence of absence.
Do not duplicate fresh-cell evidence across reconciliation rounds.
next_design_step: Determine whether the existing interval sufficient statistics can express the same calibrated M1 likelihood within P04 scope; if supporting fields are necessary, explicitly document their dataflow and limit changes to this gate. Do not silently invent a second absence model or a new cutoff.
